criteria.name: Task fit
criteria.question: Does the fixed artifact satisfy the original objective, fixed values, constraints and acceptance criteria?

criteria.name: Shared semantics
criteria.question: Does each applicable shared definition and four-field contract retain the intended identity, mission, scope, output and safety?

criteria.name: Host fit
criteria.question: Do applicable native mechanics match the selected guides, snapshots, profile, tool policy and declared surface?

criteria.name: Dependency usefulness
criteria.question: Are required delivery/loading edges complete and useful, with optional integrations and unavailable dependencies explicit?

criteria.name: Evidence truthfulness
criteria.question: Do inventory, diff, check receipts and claims distinguish deterministic consistency, quality findings and actual Host proof?

criteria.name: Provenance and ownership
criteria.question: Are inspected sources, licences, comparison, notices, authorship, ownership and unresolved holds represented truthfully?

criteria.name: Clarity and maintainability
criteria.question: Are instructions coherent, concise, useful and maintainable, with appropriate examples, disclosure and bounded repair guidance?
